story.title: Paytm Bets on Agentic AI and Wealthtech as Core Growth Pillars After RBI Payments Bank Shutdown
story.summary: In its Q4 FY26 earnings call, Paytm revealed a strategic pivot toward agentic AI and wealthtech services as the primary drivers of its next growth phase, following the RBI-mandated shutdown of its payments bank arm. The company has ruled out applying for an NBFC licence, instead focusing on AI-powered financial tools and investment products for its existing user base. The shift represents a significant repositioning of one of India's largest fintech platforms toward autonomous AI-driven financial services.
